title: Toward Sustainable HPC: In-Production Deployment of Incentive-Based Power Efficiency Mechanism on the Fugaku Supercomputer
problem: Supercomputers consume massive amounts of power with significant environmental implications. Improving power efficiency while maintaining performance is critical for sustainable HPC operations.
motivation: Environmental sustainability in HPC requires novel mechanisms to incentivize users to optimize power consumption.
method: The Fugaku Points incentive-based program provides users with control knobs to apply power control functions to their jobs. Users earn reward points for achieving power efficiency improvements. The system creates economic incentives for power-aware job execution and power-optimized workload scheduling.
key_novelty: In-production deployment of an incentive-based power control mechanism that economically motivates users to reduce supercomputer power consumption.
contributions: Operational deployment and evaluation of incentive-based power control on production HPC system (Fugaku)
User-driven power optimization mechanism through economic incentives (Fugaku Points)
Documentation of operational challenges and opportunities for power-aware HPC
Framework demonstrating viability of incentive-based approaches for sustainable HPC

metrics.other: Power efficiency improvements through user adoption of power control functions

primary_theme: Incentive-based power efficiency for sustainable HPC
